fibonacci.title: The Fibonacci Bunny Garden
fibonacci.subtitle: Where the bunnies count themselves

rule.babiesGrow: A baby pair grows up next month
rule.adultsMake: Every grown-up pair makes one new baby pair each month

months.title: The bunny months
months.intro: 🐇 **Welcome to the bunny garden!** Long ago, a mathematician named Fibonacci wondered: if bunnies follow two simple rules, how fast does the garden fill up? The rules are on the card. Press **Next month** and count the pairs — and when you think you've spotted the pattern, the garden will ask YOU what comes next!
months.grewUp: The babies grew up — still 1 pair, so the sequence goes 1, 1!
months.predictPrompt: How many pairs will there be next month?
months.correct: Yes! Watch the garden fill up! 🎉
months.retry: Hmm, count again — how many pairs are here now, and how many will be born?
months.retryHint2: The secret: all of last month's pairs are still here, and every grown pair adds one — last month + the month before!

sums.title: The addition secret
sums.intro: 🥕 **The head gardener checks the carrot supply.** Every month she needs to know the next number of pairs — but she never counts bunnies! Her secret: **add the last two numbers**. 2 + 3 = 5. 3 + 5 = 8. Help her continue the sequence!
sums.prompt: Add the last two numbers — what comes next?
sums.retry: Add the LAST TWO numbers on the strip…
sums.retryHint2: Here it is as a sum:
sums.done: Each Fibonacci number is just the two before it, added together. The sequence builds itself! 🥕✨

spiral.title: The golden spiral builder
spiral.intro: 🌱 **Now plant the numbers!** Give every Fibonacci number its own square garden bed: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13. Each new square hugs the ones before it — and a magical curve grows through them all. Grow all 7 beds and see what appears!
spiral.growPrompt: The dashed outline shows where the next square bed goes — grow it!
spiral.askSize: How big is the next square bed? (Remember the addition secret!)
spiral.retry: Look at the two squares it will lean on…
spiral.retryHint2: The addition secret works here too:
spiral.goldenTitle: Your spiral is complete! Now measure the whole garden…
spiral.goldenText: — the golden number φ! Rectangles with this shape appear all over nature and art.
spiral.matchPrompt: Which of these frames is the SAME shape as your garden?
spiral.matchCorrect: That's the golden rectangle — nature's favorite shape! ✨
spiral.matchRetry: Compare with your garden — not too long, not square…
spiral.done: You built the golden spiral from Fibonacci squares — the same curve hiding in shells, sunflowers and galaxies! 🌀

nature.title: The garden hunt
nature.intro: 🌸 **Out into the wild garden!** Flowers can't count… or can they? Count the petals on each flower and the arms on the pinecone. A surprise is hiding in the numbers — and one sneaky flower doesn't fit the pattern!
nature.countArms: Count the spiral arms — how many?
nature.oddOneOut: One of these flowers is NOT wearing a Fibonacci number. Which one?
nature.retry: Count again — try “Count with me”, we'll do it together!
nature.notFib: Caught it! 4 is not in the sequence. Most flowers pick Fibonacci numbers — but not all! 🕵️
nature.done: Lilies, buttercups, daisies, pinecones — the garden was counting in Fibonacci all along! 🌸

skills.add: Each Fibonacci number is the two before it, added together
skills.spiral: I can build the golden spiral from Fibonacci squares
skills.nature: I can spot Fibonacci numbers hiding in flowers and shells

fibonacci.finished: You discovered two great secrets: a sequence that builds itself by adding its last two numbers — and a golden spiral that grows from those numbers into shells, sunflowers and galaxies. The whole garden counts in Fibonacci, and now so do you. 🐇✨
